items.rationale: Nairobi rows are 120, 150 and 90. They add to 360, and 360 divided by 3 stores is 120.
Mombasa rows are 85 and 92. They add to 177, and 177 divided by 2 stores is 88.5.
No matching rows means there is nothing to average, so AVERAGEIF shows #DIV/0!, just like dividing by zero. It does not return 0 and it does not fall back to all stores. #N/A belongs to XLOOKUP.

The Nairobi total divided by the number of Nairobi rows is the Nairobi average. Dividing by COUNT(C2:C7) uses all six stores, AVERAGE(C2:C7) averages every region, and COUNTIF on the sales column looks for the word Nairobi among numbers, finds none and gives #DIV/0!.
